risk_note: RV2 (funds). adminCreatePayoutWatermark is implemented (FU-WATERMARK-ENTRY, D10-592). Nothing wrote payout_watermarks, and judgeWatermark says watermark_stale without a row, so automatic payouts could never run. The entry writes one insert-only row and its audit record: no voucher, no balance, no withdrawal changes, no migration. The measuring time is refused more than 5 minutes ahead (08 BR-WDR-18), more than 2 hours old or before the channel's latest (design/specs/admin-payouts.md, 代理补全的默认, D10-592). The check on the latest row runs under the channel's advisory lock, the one EXECUTE already took; payout-execute.ts now takes it through lockWatermarkChannel, the same SQL and key, and its existing tests pass. entered_by is the admin_users id. alipay and wechat only. W goes stale after 2 hours, so automatic payouts wait for a fresh entry during payout hours; the orchestrator is telling the owner. Not in this task: the W < 1.5P alert (B2-09j), the console dialog (F1-08gb), balance_w_expired on the dashboard.

reviews.note: round 1 (couli-runs/B2-09i/money-review-r1.json), no findings. Static, nothing executed. The implementation commit did not change after it: only rule tests were strengthened and the commit was cherry-picked onto them.

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude each round, static, not run by the reviewer. r1 fail with 2 S1 and 1 S2: the latest reading on an equal measured_at and P on amount_fen were not pinned, and one test depended on random ids. A new independent Claude added #41 to #43 and fixed the fixture, no assertion loosened. r2 on the increment pass, all closed, with 1 S2 accepted: no test here has a fee on the batch, so a condition ③ summing amount_fen would pass; that sum is B2-06c's existing code, unchanged here. The first author hit its usage limit after writing every file and left no output JSON; the red run and these reviews are what checked its work. After the first push, verify-static found one test file not formatted (the author has no shell); the implementer ran prettier on the test directory in a commit of its own before the implementation, format only, and re-ran the red check.
